notes.title: Adventures of Red & Carmine ZETA Update is Here!
New Update Released!
notes.notes:
🔥 New Update Released! 🔥
We've just rolled out a big update with tons of improvements and FULL game controller support! 🎮✨

🔹 What’s New?
✔ Checkpoint System – No more losing all progress! Continue from key points.
✔ Chest & Rune Mechanics – Unlock chests, collect runes, and activate the portal!
✔ Reworked End-Level Logic – The portal now properly activates, with clear guidance.
✔ Full Controller Support – Every action now works seamlessly on gamepads!
✔ Improved Player Mechanics – Smoother movement, interaction logic, and better animations.
✔ Clearer UI & Messages – No more confusion! Messages appear at the right time.
✔ Bug Fixes & Optimization – Say goodbye to annoying glitches!

🔻 What’s Removed?
❌ Dialog System & Fairy Rescue Mechanics – Streamlining the experience for better gameplay flow.

🚀 Jump back in and let us know what you think!

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
I apologize for the overlook, but since I do not have playtesters, I suppose this was bound to happen. The errors were silly, really - A couple of dialog mixups, gems with the spiders not working, the dragon stone was already on the fairy before her release!!

Well, I've amended everything.

Eid Mubarak to everyone!! Now that Ramadan is over, I'm going to get back to work In Sha Allah. The Holy Month just sent me on a hiatus, I was unable to keep awake or focus.

Now my priority is to work on the Menu and a couple extra UI screens so you guys can see credits and end the game correctly.

Hope to update again soon In Sha Allah! Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
It's finally here!
I have to work on a few kinks but I thought you all deserved this major update. I can work on other stuff later. So the game now has checkpoint mechanics as well as dialogs for all fairies. A couple of stupid mistakes with the platforms have been corrected, and I think the jumping platforms were not working in the previous build? Well, they're working now.
The enemy mechanics have been improved too, and so has the player movement etc.
Hope you have fun playing! Don't hesitate to share any problems.
Here is a preview of the big fairy - the one that is not in prison (though that does seem rather odd).
https://youtu.be/BKDjC-1KjcQ

Happy playing! ^^

notes.title: MORE NEWS!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
So I have been working non-stop on different features, and the one that is in store in the next update is, DIALOGS!!
All the NPCs - the fairies who you are rescuing from all over - are going to talk to you, giving you some kind of information to cross the level. Now all I have to do (as a developer), is to add the right dialogs to the right fairy. Not hard, but not that easy either. I need to think of how to throw clues at you guys  through words. ;)
Here is a preview of the big fairy - the one that is not in prison (though that does seem rather odd).
https://youtu.be/BKDjC-1KjcQ

notes.title: A bit of news
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
So the player dies and you start again, and though the things are working fine, the enemies are back and your score has reset. =)
I know this can be really annoying and a major rejection feature in a game, especially a small game, so I'm going to start working on it this week, starting today. I'm not sure how long it will take, since I don't just need to do the backend, it needs to be tested and in case it doesn't work one way, I'll have to find another way. It can take a week and it can be done in a few days. I don't know because I'm not a hard core developer, I use tutorials to add features one by one.
So I hope all of you can be patient.
I will work on the fairy release animations as soon as I'm done with this save game status functionality, and I have also started to increase the speed of various items, including the player, so the game is a little faster.
Wish me luck!

notes.title: Previous Build had a Problem
notes.notes:
For some unknown reason, while testing something different, I think I turned off the enemy mechanics. They were not detecting the player, nor attacking him.
So I am uploading another updated build. So sorry for the inconvenience.
This time I played the whole level from start to finish (not that I was able to "end" it, in the sense of game ends), and now there is no problem. Also the fall detector is fixed.
